Subject: Request: BYOK evacuation playbook + HSM attestation samples

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the walkthrough last week. As part of our SIG intake we need a couple of pieces to close the CRB assessment: a documented BYOK evacuation (emergency rotation/evacuation) playbook that describes steps, decision points, and timelines; and an example HSM attestation (operator shift attestations and vendor-signed attestation) that our auditors can tie to logs.

Specifically we are looking for:
- A short evacuation playbook (2–3 pages) covering: trigger conditions, custody handoff, emergency rewrap steps, and estimated RTO/RPO for key material.
- A redacted HSM attestation sample (PDF) showing vendor signature and operator signature blocks.
- A 6-month rotation log sample (CSV) with timestamps and operator IDs — sanitized for customer data.

Can you get these to us by Tue Dec 22? If you expect any scope gaps we can scope a follow-up timeboxed ask.

Thanks,
Samir

Ben / Samir —

Attached: byok-evacuation-playbook-v1.pdf, rotation-log-sample-2026-07-to-2026-12.csv, hsm-attestation-sample-2026-11.pdf (redacted). Summary of content and salient controls below.

Playbook highlights (one-page summary extracted):
- Trigger conditions: detectable compromise indicators, prolonged operator key absence (>48h), formal legal demand requiring emergency handback.
- Roles: Customer BYOK owner (Customer-SRE), Redwood Crypto Ops (operator guardians), HSM vendor L2 contact.
- Emergency rotation steps (high-level):
  1) Freeze new encryptions (grace window up to 60s for active requests).
  2) Snapshot active KV caches and mark affected key_id(s) for rotation.
  3) Initiate rewrap in isolated maintenance cluster; generate ephemeral wrap key in HSM; perform re-encryption; validate checksums.
  4) Promote new key version, update routing policy, and unblock traffic.
  5) Postmortem & signing: operator declares completion; security runs verification checklist.
- Estimated timelines: emergency rewrap (best case) 15–45 minutes for single-tenant BYOK keys; multi-tenant envelope operations may take up to 2 hours depending on prefix cache size.

HSM attestation notes: the attached sample includes vendor signature block and operator witness signatures. We stripped serials and tenant IDs to preserve confidentiality. For auditors: vendor attestation references FIPS module id (redacted) and includes cryptographic Q/A on entropy source.

Rotation CSV: redacted sample shows rotation_time in UTC, operator_id pseudonymized, key_id replaced with stable token (key-XXXX). We can produce a signed hash of the CSV on request.

Attachments: byok-evacuation-playbook-v1.pdf (customer-facing narrative), hsm-attestation-sample-2026-11.pdf (redacted vendor attestation), rotation-log-sample-2026-07-to-2026-12.csv (sanitized).

If you'd like, we can add an operator-signed .csv checksum (SHA256) and a short attestation letter from Crypto Ops.

Karthik Iyer

Redwood Inference
